detail:
no meta-ad-library credential in this org — meta-ad-library.meta-ads.library.search is a marketplace endpoint
  connect one:  treg connections connect --provider meta-ad-library
  or add a key: treg secret add meta-ad-library --env-var META_AD_LIBRARY_API_KEY
  or register the tool yourself: treg tool add meta-ad-library --base-url https://graph.facebook.com/v21.0 …
another provider serves meta-ads.library.search:
  crawl4ai.meta-ads.library.search  ~$0.00165/call  (callable now on treg's key)
  scrapecreators.x.v1-facebook-adlibrary-search-ads  ~$0.00188/call  (callable now on treg's key)
  apify.meta-ads.library.search  ~$0.005/call  (callable now on treg's key)
